searchText: Hey folks. I really feel like BIP32 has terrible developer experience. Why don’t we introduce a proper alternative, that works for all curves (including BLS when needed)? There is no need to remove backwards compatibility, just something to think for the new future products. Should I create EIP for that? https://gist.github.com/paulmillr/a3f2c2aa3cbc70d3457685a85621225a I'm a fan, but know that there have been multiple attempts to standardize on something better than BIP32/44/39 and they all have failed. Be prepared to spend a huge amount of effort pestering all of the stakeholders and potentially writing PRs yourself to many libraries/wallets in order to get something like this pushed through. I’m used to it. Hi there, can someone tell.me how to deal with defi-eth I wan to one event 3.88 eth, i tried to withdraw them in my wallet and they blocked my account. After that they asked me to add 35% from tge existing amount in my mining pool to unlock it, i did add and some more and the account is still locked. This is not the place. You’re flameposting here. They request the second deposit because without mentioning before the first one that the deposit should be exact. I did the second deposit helped by a friend because i did not have all the money and i made the deposit from 2 diferent wallet. Account and the money are still blocked and they are accussing me now for money laundering and they request tobdeposit an amount of 45% from the total amount in the mining pool How can i go out from this situation to get my money invested back? Scammed <@570268431522201601> maybe some day we will be able to just use Clang. https://godbolt.org/z/qcsfrjM57 I remember seeing something in LLVM mailing list or review about overflow having different semantics from carry in some cases. Have to check if I savec the thread though
